beliefs: f inserts a 2-char token at position len//2 (floor) for all non-empty strings [E1, E2, E3, E4, E6]
For even-length strings the token is always '8I' [E2, E5, E6]
For odd-length strings the token is always 'I8' [E2, E3, E4, E6]
Orientation depends only on length parity, not on character content or position parity [E3, E4, E5, E6]
